entries.decision: Decorate only an actual JIS V1.0 XSD INVALID result caused by a second LineInformation element in AllLineInformationData.
guards: official JourneyInformationService V1.0 strict profile only
match only a second LineInformation in JourneyInformationService.AllLineInformationData
must not relax cardinality to the PDF-documented 1:*

entries.decision: Decorate only an actual JIS V1.0 XSD INVALID result caused by using SpecificGNSSPointInformationData as the response choice element instead of SpecificGNSSPointInformation.
guards: official JourneyInformationService V1.0 strict profile only
must preserve SpecificGNSSPointInformation as the XML element name
must preserve JourneyInformationService.SpecificGNSSPointInformationData as the type name
must not register the Data-suffixed PDF row label as an element alias or rewrite it
